A logic issue broke the permissions restrictions on link shares that originated from outside a users home storage, such as link shares from files on groupfolder or external storages. Any such link shares gave full write permissions to the contents of the share, regardless of the configured permissions for the share.

### Patches

<!-- Adjust component name and version. "Nextcloud Enterprise" is only needed for Server and shipped apps -->

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 32.0.12 or 33.0.6 or 34.0.1 
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 32.0.12 or  33.0.6

### Workarounds

The only workaround is to disable link shares or remove share permissions from group folders or external storages.


### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [Public ticket](https://github.com/nextcloud/server/issues/61021)
